title: bubbletea's init queries every terminal: ~5s per call on a silent pty
body:
The ticfac binary links bubbletea v1.3.5 (via internal/factory/dashboard, the `ticfac factory dashboard` view), and bubbletea's package init calls lipgloss v1 HasDarkBackground: an OSC 11 + CSI 6n query on /dev/tty that runs before any command body, on every invocation. On a terminal that does not answer (script(1), CI ptys, likely Bombadil's pty driver for z7w) it burns ~5s of select timeouts per invocation and leaves query bytes on the wire; measured: `script -q /dev/null ticfac version` = 5.0s where the same call without a pty is 0.006s. Every ticfac call in the cloud sandbox and in CI ptys pays this, watch or not.
evidence: goroutine dump of a running invocation: github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea@v1.3.5/tea_init.go:21 -> lipgloss@v1.1.0/renderer.go:132 -> termenv@v0.16.0/termenv_unix.go:275 (termStatusReport on /dev/tty, blocked in unix.Select); command: time script -q /dev/null ticfac version (5.0s) vs time ticfac version (0.006s)
